criteria.requirement: Repair tqdm.contrib.itertools.product repeat handling via operator.index before computing totals or delegating to itertools.product. Preserve Python arbitrary-precision exponent totals for numpy integer repeats and custom __index__ objects, standard zero/negative/nonintegral behavior, yielded combinations and explicit total precedence. Do not preconsume unknown-length inputs to infer total; total remains None where lengths are unavailable. Test actual product generation and wrapper-observed totals without enumerating astronomically large products. Preserve other combinator wrappers.

Investigate the real source, explain the call path and clarify the business requirements before obtaining plan approval and implementing. Deliver real engineering changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. Repair independently reported failures; questions, answers and documentation do not count as separate completed objectives.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual business behavior and the frozen scope; do not grade by matching the reference patch text.
